subject: Proposal: staged uplift, co-term and credit orchestration for Novamed renewal
messages:

To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: arjun.menon@novamed.com
Date: 2026-10-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal and mid-year growth planning

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're getting internal momentum to expand usage across two additional product teams and would like to understand options for: (1) adding 40% more capacity mid-contract, (2) aligning the renewal to our fiscal year (co-term to 2027-07-01), and (3) whether there are bridge credits or phased billing you can offer while we firm up a PO.

Our procurement lead (cc'd) asked for a simple side-by-side of a staged uplift vs. an immediate annualize option. Can you send something concise we can share? Also flag any timing constraints for signing before November.

Best,
Priya Kapoor
Head of Platform Ops | Novamed
priya.kapoor@novamed.com
+1 415-555-0142
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Priya Kapoor <priya.kapoor@novamed.com>
Cc: arjun.menon@novamed.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal and mid-year growth planning

Priya — thanks for the clear ask. Attached is a lightweight model (Novamed_uplift_model_v1.xlsx) that compares three paths:

- Staged uplift (40% capacity now, remaining 60% phased over 3 months) + 8% uplift discount off list for staged commitment
- Immediate annualize (annual commitment upsized to new runrate) + 12% one-time uplift discount
- Bridge-only (short-term burst capacity with monthly true-up) + no uplift discount but credits applied if you convert to annual within 90 days

High level notes: co-terming to 2027-07-01 is possible; we map invoice timing to your fiscal quarter and can offer a prorated invoice for the remainder of current term. If you need guaranteed throughput SLOs during the phased period we recommend dedicated capacity lanes (we've marked the delta in the sheet).

Quick ask from our side: can you confirm target signature date and whether Novamed requires PO before DocuSign? If you want, Ben (cc) can run a short TCO calc for your infra team during the staged window.

I'll follow up with internal pricing options.

Cheers,
Hannah Schmitt
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com

Hannah / Marissa — forwarding Novamed's note and the model Hannah attached. I ran the staged uplift numbers through our margin model and attached a short offer PDF (Redwood_uplift_offer_20261004.pdf). Highlights:

- Staged path: Effective blended unit price down 6.5% vs list across 12 months (assumes conversion of remaining 60% within 90 days).
- Annualize path: 12% discount for full annual committed upsizing, requires 60% of uplift committed at signing.
- Bridge-only: monthly true-up, no discount but we provide 1 month credit (up to $10k) if converted within 60 days.

I flagged a couple of legal terms that need Marissa's approval (credit expiry language + SLA appendix). If Marissa signs off on the credit expiration window we can present the staged offer to Novamed tomorrow.

Attachments: Redwood_uplift_offer_20261004.pdf

-Ben
Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-02T10:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Novamed uplift model + draft offer

Thanks Ben — reviewed. Approve moving forward with the staged path subject to the following guardrails:

1) Discount cap at 12% for any path (no escalations beyond this without VP approval).
2) Bridge credit expiry: credits must be used within 90 days of issuance (documented in amendment).
3) Co-term: Novamed must agree to align to 2027-07-01 and sign the amendment; otherwise default to monthly true-up pricing.

If you and Hannah are aligned, present the staged-offer with the amendment and mention these conditions explicitly in the cover email. I'll be available for final legal handoff Tuesday afternoon.

-Marissa Cole
VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Priya Kapoor <priya.kapoor@novamed.com>, Arjun Menon <arjun.menon@novamed.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-04T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal and mid-year growth planning — Redwood proposed path

Hi Priya / Arjun — following internal approvals, here is the proposed path we recommend for Novamed (summary and asks below). The formal amendment and offer PDF are attached.

Summary (recommended): staged uplift + co-term
- Immediate: add 40% capacity now on a staged uplift commitment. We apply a blended 8% uplift discount immediately.
- Phase: remaining 60% to be committed within 90 days; if converted within 90 days the blended discount rises to 12% (per Marissa's cap).
- Credits: Redwood will issue a one-time bridge credit (equal to one month of uplift at current rates, up to $10k) if Novamed converts the remaining uplift within 60 days. Credits expire 90 days after issuance.
- Co-term: we will align renewal to 2027-07-01. In the amendment we prorate remaining months of current term and show invoice timing aligned to your fiscal quarter.

Next steps we need from Novamed:
1) Confirm whether Procurement needs a PO before DocuSign — if yes, provide PO template and target PO date.
2) Approve the staged offer and credit terms (reply with "Approve" or share redlines).
3) If approved, we'll push the amendment to DocuSign and make it effective on signature date.

Attached: Redwood_uplift_offer_20261004.pdf, Novamed_uplift_model_v1.xlsx

On timing — if we receive approval and PO by 2026-10-20 we can guarantee the bridge credit and preserve the 90-day conversion window. After that the offer remains available but credits will be subject to new review.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 20-minute call if you prefer to walk the numbers.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
